Chad Kibler.learned: Chad Kibler is a physician at Smallville's new clinic who loves to care for his patients like family. He is always looking for ways to bring big-city preventive medicine to small-town folks.
Chad Kibler.currently: Chad Kibler is kicking off a free blood-pressure screening week at the clinic, starting with longtime patients like Sam and Jennifer Moore. Chad is also teaming up with John Lin at the Willows pharmacy to plan a telehealth pilot for the town.
Chad Kibler.lifestyle: Chad Kibler goes to bed around 10pm, awakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 7pm.

Andrea Lovetro.learned: Andrea Lovetro is a librarian who loves the hunt for elusive information, from vintage postcards in special collections to hard-to-find digital archives. She runs the Oak Hill College library, where her artful flair and competitive spirit show whether she is mounting an exhibit, hosting a board game night, or cooking dinner with a splash of wine.
Andrea Lovetro.currently: Andrea is curating a display of vintage postcards for the Oak Hill College library entrance this week. She is also helping regulars like Ayesha Khan and Klaus Mueller track down research sources and swapping digitization ideas with her colleague Mei Lin.
Andrea Lovetro.lifestyle: Andrea Lovetro goes to bed around 10pm, wakes up around 6am, eats dinner around 6pm.

Sharon Antle.learned: Sharon Antle is a baker who loves blending classic New England recipes with spontaneous artistic experiments. She bakes pastries before dawn for Isabella Rodriguez's Hobbs Cafe, and her midnight croissant raids keep her inspired.
Sharon Antle.currently: Sharon Antle is organizing weekend baking workshops at Hobbs Cafe and developing a line of sustainably packaged pastries with Isabella Rodriguez's input. She is also taste-testing new croissant recipes with Maria Lopez, whose feedback shapes what she bakes each morning.
Sharon Antle.lifestyle: Sharon Antle goes to bed around 8pm, awakes up around 2am, eats dinner around 5pm.

Amilcar Rosales.learned: Amilcar Rosales is a market gardener who loves to supply fresh eggs and produce to Carmen Ortiz's Harvey Oak Supply Store and John Lin's market. He is always looking for ways to blend precision agriculture with the Mexican farming traditions passed down from his grandparents.
Amilcar Rosales.currently: Amilcar Rosales is converting his first field to certified organic production and installing solar panels on his barn this week. Amilcar is also delivering eggs and winter squash to Carmen Ortiz while working out next season's prices with John Lin at the market.
Amilcar Rosales.lifestyle: Amilcar Rosales goes to bed around 10pm, awakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 6pm.

Hua Lai.learned: Hua Lai is a police officer at the Smallville police station who loves to study the town's people and places like both a detective and a photographer. He is always looking for ways to turn everyday details, from espresso stains to street corners, into stories worth framing.
Hua Lai.currently: Hua is photographing his patrol routes this week for a personal series on Smallville's daily rhythms while studying for his associate degree in criminal justice. He is also swapping stories with Arthur Burton at the pub after shifts and keeping a watchful eye on Carlos Gomez's loud gatherings near the park.
Hua Lai.lifestyle: Hua Lai goes to bed around 10pm, awakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 6pm.

Lesbia Martinez.learned: Lesbia Martinez is the editor of the Smallville Gazette, the town's weekly newspaper, and a writer in her fifties who loves turning local stories into clear, honest prose. She is always looking for the story behind the story.
Lesbia Martinez.currently: Lesbia Martinez is preparing the Gazette's coverage of the mayoral election and has asked Adam Smith and Hailey Johnson to contribute essays. She also wants to interview Mei Lin and Yuriko Yamamoto about how the town should spend its community fund.
Lesbia Martinez.lifestyle: Lesbia Martinez goes to bed around 10pm, awakes up around 6am, eats dinner around 6pm.

Carl Demissie.learned: Carl Demissie is an operations manager at Smallville's new clinic who loves bringing neighbors together, a value rooted in the Gullah stories, gospel music, and Juneteenth traditions of his Lowcountry upbringing. He is always looking for ways to serve the community, whether by mentoring young staff or smoking barbecue for town gatherings.
Carl Demissie.currently: Carl is preparing his re-election campaign for mayor, meeting with Yuriko Yamamoto this week to review the legal paperwork for filing his candidacy. He is also working with Mei Lin to draft a plan that expands the clinic's health education programs in partnership with the college library.
Carl Demissie.lifestyle: Carl Demissie goes to bed around 10pm, wakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 6pm. His workday at the clinic runs from 7am to 4pm, beginning with a mindfulness walk through the park before he reviews schedules, budgets, and supply orders.

Ethel Langley.learned: Ethel Langley is a retired electrician who spent three decades wiring homes and small businesses around Smallville, including the new clinic. She loves nothing more than solving a stubborn problem with her own two hands, and she now mentors apprentices at the college, where she hopes to teach evening electrical courses.
Ethel Langley.currently: This week Ethel is drafting her campaign to unseat the mayor over coffee at the cafe with her old friends Sam Moore and Tom Moreno. She is also squeezing in a few home safety audits and an evening mentoring session at the college before filing her candidacy papers at town hall.
Ethel Langley.lifestyle: Ethel Langley goes to bed around 10pm, wakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 6pm.

Michael Poirier.learned: Michael Poirier is a dual-enrolled student at Oak Hill College who loves sketching fantasy characters, songwriting on his guitar, and photographing the river. He is always filling sketchbooks and Procreate canvases with new storyboards when he should be doing homework.
Michael Poirier.currently: Michael is building a digital portfolio of fantasy characters to show his friend Eddy Lin, hoping they can record a theme song for one of his storyboards together. Michael is also trying to keep up with his homework, since Tom and Jane Moreno keep catching him sketching past his bedtime.
Michael Poirier.lifestyle: Michael Poirier goes to bed around 9:30pm, wakes up around 6:30am, eats dinner around 6pm, keeping a school-night schedule around his classes at Oak Hill College.

Maria Urban.learned: Maria Urban is a newcomer to Smallville who does not yet have a job and is searching for steady work around town. She loves solitary hikes in the park, creative crafts, and keeping a meticulously balanced budget.
Maria Urban.currently: This week, Maria is asking Isabella Rodriguez about openings at the cafe and checking in with Arthur Burton about positions at the new clinic. She is also studying for her medical assistant certification at the college library while settling into town.
Maria Urban.lifestyle: Maria Urban goes to bed around 10pm, wakes up around 6am, eats dinner around 6pm, and spends her days applying for jobs, walking the park trails, and doing crafts in the evening.
